# dsh-profile-share
**English** | 简体中文
> Share a DSH plugin setup as one pasteable code.

`dsh-profile-share` packages the plugins you selected in a DSH profile — their enabled state and
you

r explicit configuration — into a single short code. Another machine pastes that code and ends
up wi

th the same setup; subsequent codes carry only what changed. The same page then reports which
API ke

ys, environment variables and logins each machine still has to supply for itself, because
credential
s never travel in the code.
## Features

- **Export** — pick plugins (all / none / invert), generate one `DSH-SHARE/1:` code. Suspected
crede

ntial fields are stripped by default and every stripped path is listed.
- **Apply** — paste a code,

preview the exact diff, then apply it. Only additions and updates by
default; nothing is disabled or

removed unless you turn on full alignment.
- **First-run configuration** — one page listing the cre

dentials a machine still needs, with the
secret fields writable there and login-only plugins linked
to their own settings.
## Requirements

- A DSH profile that mounts the `pluginManager` and `configEditor` services (the desktop and web
pro

files of DSH 0.2.x do). Endpoints answer `503` with an explicit message when either is absent.
- Nod

e.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` for the host half.
- The receiving machine needs this plugin installed t
oo; a share code alone cannot bootstrap it.
## Installation
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or, from the plugin manager, install this checkout as a local directory. Restart DSH once after
inst
alling. The page lives in **Settings → 分享与同步** (section id `profile-sync`).
## Usage
### 1. Export a code

Open **Settings → 分享与同步 → 分享**, tick the plugins you want to carry over, and press
**生成分享码**. The re
sult is one line of text; copy it and send it however you like.
### 2. Apply a code

On the other machine open the **同步** tab, paste the code, press **预览**, and read the plan:
installat
ions, enable/disable switches, and configuration writes. Press **应用** to run it.
### 3. Finish credentials

Open **首次配置**. Every detected requirement is listed as a secret, an environment variable, or a
login
. Fill in your own values — the sender's keys were never in the code.
The page never shows a bare input box. Every item carries what the plugin can actually prove:

- the provider's application page, matched from the environment variable name, the configured base
U

RL, the row id or the bundle name (DeepSeek, 阿里云百炼, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Moonshot,
智谱, MiniMax

, 硅基流动, OpenRouter, 火山方舟, Groq, WorkBuddy);
- a copyable `setx` / `export` command for environment v
the plugin's config schema, when it documents itself.

Requirements that match a flow registered through `ctx.authorization` also get a **直接授权**
button. Th

e flow runs in the background: its links and its questions come back to this page, and
whatever it c

ommits is the plugin's own credential record — not this plugin guessing at a config
field. Flows tha

t ask for a secret are never answered from chat; the agent tool refuses and points
at the page inste

sk for a secret are never answered from chat; the agent tool refuses and points
at the page instead.
## Bootstrap on a machine that does not have the plugin

A share code cannot install its own reader, so a handoff starts with one message. The **分享**
tab's *
*复制引导语（含码）** button copies exactly this:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The receiving agent reads it, asks whether to install the plugin — that is the confirmation step —
i

nstalls it through the plugin manager, calls `profile_share_import` for a preview, applies it once
y

ou agree, and then reports what is still missing, which is the same list the **首次配置** page
shows.

Why the message instead of full automation: nothing in a bare DSH can recognise a `DSH-SHARE/1:`
str

ing before the plugin that understands it is installed. A prefix detector in DSH core would
remove t
he message entirely; until then this two-line prompt is the seam.
### Agent tools
| Tool | Purpose |

| `profile_share_import` | preview a share code, or apply it with `apply: true` |
| `profile_share_r
equirements` | list the credentials this profile still lacks, with the same guidance the page shows

|
| `profile_share_authorize` | list authorization flows, start one, read its prompts, answer a non-
secret one, or cancel |
## Share code format
The code is `gzip(JSON)` encoded as base64url behind a `DSH-SHARE/1:` prefix. The version suffix is

checked: a code from an incompatible format is rejected instead of being half-applied. The payload
[

: a code from an incompatible format is rejected instead of being half-applied. The payload
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
The host half (`index.js`) uses only public services, so the Loader keeps owning schema validation,
the profile file lock and hot reload:
| Service call | Purpose |

| `pluginManager.listBundles()` / `listPlugins()` | read the live inventory |
| `configEditor.config

uration()` | read each row's explicit profile override |
| `configEditor.edit()` | write a row's con

figuration back through the profile patch |
| `installBundle()` / `setBundleEnabled()` / `setPluginE
nabled()` | install and switch |

Six endpoints live under `/api/dsh-profile-sync/`: `state`, `export`, `preview`, `apply`,
`requireme

nts`, `configure`. Writes require `application/json` and a same-origin request, and reuse
the host's
own `connection.requestRejection` admission decision.

The client half (`client.js`) is a single `settings.section` page registered through
`ctx.slots.regi
ster`, requires only `react`, and has no build step.
## Security
- Suspected credentials (`apiKey`, `token`, `secret`, `password`, `cookie`, …) are removed on export

by default, and the removed paths are reported. Enabling **包含可能的密钥字段** is an explicit,
deliberate a

ction.
- The code carries `apiKeyEnv`-style variable names, not the keys they name.
- Writes are sam

e-origin only and go through the profile's own configuration editor, so every change
is a normal, re
viewable profile patch.
